fees.note: Fee = roundup(0.07 x contracts x price x (1 - price)) for taker fills and roundup(0.0175 x ...) for maker fills, per Kalshi's fee schedule (effective 2026-07-07). The paper book rounds up to the cent, which never understates the fee.
